name: resourceguru-mcp
description: Every Resource Guru endpoint as a typed command, plus a local database and per-resource per-day utilization no Resource Guru report gives you.

resourceguru_email.title: RESOURCEGURU_EMAIL
resourceguru_email.description: Your Resource Guru account email, used for HTTP Basic auth to the Resource Guru API.

resourceguru_password.title: RESOURCEGURU_PASSWORD
resourceguru_password.description: Your Resource Guru account password, used for HTTP Basic auth to the Resource Guru API.

resourceguru_base_url.title: Resource Guru API base URL
resourceguru_base_url.description: Base URL for the Resource Guru API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

resourceguru_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
resourceguru_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to list only read-only tools: resourceguru_execute, sync and import are then not listed. Leave blank to keep every tool.
